## Review checklist

- [ ] Screenshots or recordings are attached for UI changes, or not applicable.
- [ ] Accessibility impact was reviewed.
- [ ] API impact was documented, or there is none.
- [ ] Environment-variable impact was documented, or there is none.
- [ ] Security and privacy impact was reviewed.
- [ ] Rollback considerations were documented.
- [ ] Documentation was updated, or no update is required.
